perf.notes: v0.41 L3 packaging/perf UPGRADE: after unused-attr strip (v0.40), mergeSameMaterialMeshes compactIndexToUint16-copies a >16-bit index into Uint16 when position.count ≤ 65535 (no-op if no index, verts exceed 65535, or index is already ≤2 bytes/element). concatGeometries always builds Uint32; weldCoincidentVertices only rewrites to Uint16 when it actually reduces verts — compact is the safety net for weld early-return and packaged Uint32 indices. Does not change triangle or vertex count. Fastener (fastener / fastenerMesh) stays outside the LOD merge skip set but now gets the same unused-attr strip + compact (procedural create and packaged ingest of an authored root-level MeshBasic; do not invent a fastener). Does not merge across body / lidPivot / latchPivot / tool, into colliders, or fold fastener into an LOD batch. Does not rewrite materials, strip maps, or invent fake LODs.
